budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: S81-KP4 10-17: BACK hard sub-tile of the KP4 decoder cluster ot_s81_kp4_dec (split of the one-tile streaming decoder, see s81lk_kp4_deca). Forward Chien + Forney over 55 lanes in two registered stages (Lambda / Omega X^-30 / Lambda_odd evaluation; error value with a kept-hierarchy inverse LUT, so yosys cannot fold the E1 register into an inferred ROM: the one-tile gate showed Rl -> inverse 17 levels 683 ps), 64-leaf balanced root-count tree, decision, correction masks re-cut to PMA words and delayed in the 32 x 546 SRAM u_cmem on the 43.2 lattice, corrected words straight from the seam input + SRAM read port, fixed-offset beat select (16 kept copies). West face = the seam from s81lk_kp4_deca (pin positions identical to deca's east face); east face = core side (q_* full face); clk / rst_n S centre, counters S. Exact vs rs544.py through the cluster (KP4 bench base PASS; Forney mutant DMUT 2 FAIL).
